{"baseRefName":"main","body":"# 33GOD-55: Make the global Git travel guard merge-aware for remote-known ancestry

Immutable reviewed range: `36d3ed6627b1ee1819952617d7d4ebfcebc2708f..54aca968fd16e428fe1378f6f401c068d17e5c4a` (base `36d3ed6627b1ee1819952617d7d4ebfcebc2708f`, head `54aca968fd16e428fe1378f6f401c068d17e5c4a`, exactly one commit).

## Changed files (exactly four)

- `git/README.md`
- `git/hooks/_travels.py`
- `git/hooks/pre-push`
- `git/tests/test_pre_push.py`

## What changed

The global pre-push travel guard now derives the outgoing-commit set from live `ls-remote` advertisements of the destination and every configured fetch remote, enforces exact pre-push advertised old-SHA equality per ref, and subtracts reachable advertised ancestry using combined merge diffs — so remote-known integration ancestry is no longer rescanned, while unpublished side parents and novel merge-resolution content are still scanned. Credential scanning, fail-closed behavior, branch deletion, and local-hook chaining are preserved.

## Verification

- **RED reproduction**: base-revision hook (`36d3ed6`) blocks the authentic clean merged topology; both `MergeTopologyTests` clean-merge tests fail under the old guard and pass at the reviewed head. Independently reproduced by both reviewers.
- **GREEN**: full suite 25/25 tests pass (`python3 -m unittest discover -s git/tests`), plus compileall, `bash -n`, `_travels.py HEAD`, and `git diff --check` gates all green.
- **Exact 33GOD-54 read-only proof**: the authentic blocked candidate `750ad5ccd79e1ea4dd6725486b2849c2a0defa1d` against advertised old SHA `cc00fe6ef855e506ad1bf8166473eecf725af8a8` passes the reviewed hook with exit 0 and exactly 1 unpublished commit, no bypass, no push; candidate HEAD/refs/status, fork ref, upstream PR NousResearch/hermes-agent#102409, and all three blocker-evidence artifact hashes verified byte-identical before and after.
- **Spec-compliance review**: PASS (independent, `kimi-code`).
- **Quality/security review**: PASS (independent, `github-copilot`).

## Carried nonblocking finding

- **LOW / test-coverage** (nonblocking): the focused regression suite does not directly cover SHA-256 repositories, annotated tag push advertisements, SIGTERM interruption during an active fetch, or preservation of a caller-provided custom `GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY`/alternate object store. Primary SHA-1 merge topology is fully covered.
